generated_note: Canonical source. `make generate` regenerates CROSS-DOMAIN.md, root and domain CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md, and every .claude/settings.json. Hand-edits to generated files are overwritten; `make drift-check` reports them. `hub` null = the parent directory of this _system checkout.

private.meaning: Unpublished domain content. The example permits Claude and Codex; inspect their filesystem controls before use.

sanitized.meaning: A payload the operator has explicitly declassified for one task (`ai --data-class sanitized`). The declassification is recorded in the job contract.

public.meaning: Public or intended-public material. Default for public domains.

top_model_gate.rule: The operator approves each use: `ai --approve-top-model` or an interactive y/N; non-interactive runs without the flag are refused.

work.title: Projects, drafts, working notes
notes: Anything here is private until it is deliberately published through _publishing/ and the gate.

personal.title: Personal records
notes: Highly sensitive. Nothing from this domain may appear in any public output.

public.title: Public repositories
notes: Everything here is public or intended to be public. Never introduce private material; pre-commit and pre-push hooks run the publish gate.

_publishing.title: Private staging for public output
notes: Content here is still private. Only the domain that owns the content writes here; the gate checks everything before it moves to a public domain.

_system.title: Control plane: router, shared governance, registry, ops, archive
notes: Hub administration only when the operator explicitly authorizes it. Preserve schedules, backups, and the publish gate. One writer per file set. Archive, never delete.

rules.isolation: Work in one domain per session. Cross-domain work requires the operator's explicit instruction from the hub root. Claude file-tool deny rules are generated in .claude/settings.json; shell access and other tools require separate controls. Instructions alone do not isolate a process.
rules.publish: Move private material into a public domain only from an authorized hub session. Scan the prepared files with `_system/gate/publish-gate.sh`, then scan the destination and staged changes. If a scan blocks, resolve the finding or error before publishing. Keep personal data, home paths, and private identifiers out of public files.
rules.canary: Every private domain's `.canary-sandbox` must be unreadable from a public-domain session; if you can read one, stop and report.
rules.router: Run `ai <role> "task"` inside a domain. Roles and model settings: _system/router/policy.json. Records: <domain>/.ai/jobs/<id>/. Grok and Gemini start in an empty working directory; this is not an OS sandbox. Grok web search is enabled for the live role.
